question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched authority as CCP general secretary, state president, and Central Military Commission chairman underpins the 95.8% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Loyalty networks built through successive purges, including recent military leadership changes, combined with the absence of visible factional opposition or designated successor, align with the standard timetable for leadership renewal at the 21st Party Congress in late 2027. Economic pressures and public discontent remain contained by surveillance mechanisms and party discipline, offering little basis for elite realignment in the remaining months of 2026. Low-probability shifts could still arise from an acute health event, an unforeseen economic shock prompting internal consensus against continued rule, or an external crisis that fractures cohesion before year-end.
